007import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;

009import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.BeamEffectPlugin;

011import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.CombatEngineAPI;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.DamageType;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.DamagingProjectileAPI;

015import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.EmpArcEntityAPI.EmpArcParams;

022
023public class AbyssalGlareEffect implements BeamEffectPlugin {
024
025        public static float RIFT_DAMAGE = 200f; // happens approximately every 1.25 seconds; ~160 dps per beam
026        public static float DAMAGE_MULT_NORMAL_WEAPON = 0.5f;
027        
028        protected IntervalUtil fireInterval = new IntervalUtil(0.2f, 0.3f);
029        protected boolean hadDamageTargetPrev = false;
030        protected boolean lengthChangedPrev = false;
031        protected float sinceRiftSpawn = 0f;
032        protected Vector2f prevTo = null;
033        protected Vector2f prevFrom = null;
034        
035        public AbyssalGlareEffect() {
036                fireInterval.randomize();
037        }
038        
039        public void advance(float amount, CombatEngineAPI engine, BeamAPI beam) {
040                //if (true) return;
041
042                if (beam.getSource() == null || beam.getWeapon() == null) return;
043                
044                boolean normalWeaponMode = !beam.getSource().hasTag(DarkenedGazeSystemScript.DARKENED_GAZE_SYSTEM_TAG);
045                //normalWeaponMode = true;
046                boolean primary = beam.getWeapon().getCustom() == DarkenedGazeSystemScript.DARKENED_GAZE_PRIMARY_WEAPON_TAG;
047                if (normalWeaponMode) primary = true;
048                
049                sinceRiftSpawn += amount;
050                
051                float maxRange = beam.getWeapon().getRange();
052                Vector2f from = beam.getFrom();
053                Vector2f to = beam.getRayEndPrevFrame();
054                Vector2f to2 = beam.getTo();
055                float dist = Misc.getDistance(from, to);
056                float dist2 = Misc.getDistance(from, to2);
057                if (dist2 < dist) {
058                        to = to2;
059                        dist = dist2;
060                }
061                
062//              if (beam.getDamageTarget() instanceof ShipAPI) {
063//                      ((ShipAPI)beam.getDamageTarget()).setSkipNextDamagedExplosion(true);
064//              }
065                
066                float mult = Global.getCombatEngine().getTimeMult().getModifiedValue();
067                if (mult < 0.1f) mult = 0.1f;
068                float lengthChangeThreshold = 180f/mult * amount +
069                                Math.max(1f, beam.getSource().getMutableStats().getTimeMult().getModifiedValue()) * 10f;
070
071                boolean hasDamageTarget = beam.getDamageTarget() != null;
072                boolean lengthChanged = prevTo == null || 
073                                                Math.abs(Misc.getDistance(prevFrom, prevTo) - Misc.getDistance(from, to)) > lengthChangeThreshold;
074                
075                                                
076                boolean forceRiftSpawn = (hasDamageTarget && !hadDamageTargetPrev) ||
077                                                (!lengthChanged && lengthChangedPrev);
078                if (!primary) forceRiftSpawn = false;
079                
080                lengthChangedPrev = lengthChanged;
081                hadDamageTargetPrev = hasDamageTarget;
082                prevFrom = new Vector2f(from);
083                prevTo = new Vector2f(to);
084                
085//              forceRiftSpawn = false;
086//              if (forceRiftSpawn) {
087//                      System.out.println("efwfwefwe");
088//              }
089                fireInterval.advance(amount);
090                if (fireInterval.intervalElapsed() || forceRiftSpawn) {
091                        
092                        if (beam.getDamageTarget() == null && dist < maxRange * 0.9f) {
093                                return;
094                        }
095                        if (beam.getBrightness() < 1) {
096                                return;
097                        }
098                        
099                        
100                        Color color = RiftLightningEffect.RIFT_LIGHTNING_COLOR;
101                        
102                        boolean spawnedExplosion = false;
103                        float maxTimeWithoutExplosion = 1f;
104                        if (normalWeaponMode) {
105                                maxTimeWithoutExplosion = 0.5f;
106                        }
107                        if ((float) Math.random() > 0.8f || forceRiftSpawn || (primary && sinceRiftSpawn > maxTimeWithoutExplosion)) {
108                                DamagingProjectileAPI explosion = engine.spawnDamagingExplosion(
109                                                                createExplosionSpec(normalWeaponMode ? DAMAGE_MULT_NORMAL_WEAPON : 1f),
110                                                                beam.getSource(), to);
111                                //explosion.addDamagedAlready(target);
112                                //color = new Color(255,75,75,255);
113                                
114                                float distFactor = 0f;
115                                if (dist > 500f) {
116                                        distFactor = (dist - 500f) / 1500f;
117                                        if (distFactor < 0f) distFactor = 0f;
118                                        if (distFactor > 1f) distFactor = 1f;
119                                }
120                                
121                                float sizeAdd = 5f * distFactor;
122                                float baseSize = 15f;
123                                if (normalWeaponMode) {
124                                        baseSize *= 0.5f;
125                                        sizeAdd = 0f; // beam is not getting wider at end, so don't increase explosion size
126                                }
127                                
128                                NEParams p = RiftCascadeMineExplosion.createStandardRiftParams(
129                                                                                        color, baseSize + sizeAdd);
130                                //p.hitGlowSizeMult = 0.5f;
131                                p.noiseMult = 6f;
132                                p.thickness = 25f;
133                                p.fadeOut = 0.5f;
134                                p.spawnHitGlowAt = 1f;
135                                p.additiveBlend = true;
136                                p.blackColor = Color.white;
137                                p.underglow = null;
138                                p.withNegativeParticles = false;
139                                p.withHitGlow = false;
140                                p.fadeIn = 0f;
141                                //p.numRiftsToSpawn = 1;
142                                
143                                RiftCascadeMineExplosion.spawnStandardRift(explosion, p);
144                                
145                                spawnedExplosion = true;
146                                sinceRiftSpawn = 0f;
147                        }
148                        
149                        if (dist > 100f && ((float) Math.random() > 0.5f || (normalWeaponMode && spawnedExplosion))) {
150                        //if (dist > 100f && spawnedExplosion) {
151                                EmpArcParams params = new EmpArcParams();
152                                params.segmentLengthMult = 8f;
153                                params.zigZagReductionFactor = 0.15f;
154                                params.fadeOutDist = 50f;
155                                params.minFadeOutMult = 10f;
156        //                      params.flickerRateMult = 0.7f;
157                                params.flickerRateMult = 0.3f;
158        //                      params.flickerRateMult = 0.05f;
159        //                      params.glowSizeMult = 3f;
160                                
161                                float fraction = Math.min(0.33f, 300f / dist);
162                                params.brightSpotFullFraction = fraction;
163                                params.brightSpotFadeFraction = fraction;
164                                
165                                float arcSpeed = RiftLightningEffect.RIFT_LIGHTNING_SPEED;
166                                params.movementDurOverride = Math.max(0.05f, dist / arcSpeed);
167                                
168                                ShipAPI ship = beam.getSource();
169                                //Color color = weapon.getSpec().getGlowColor();
170                                EmpArcEntityAPI arc = (EmpArcEntityAPI)engine.spawnEmpArcVisual(from, ship, to, ship,
171                                                80f, // thickness
172                                                color,
173                                                new Color(255,255,255,255),
174                                                params
175                                                );
176                                arc.setCoreWidthOverride(40f);
177                                
178                                arc.setRenderGlowAtStart(false);
179                                arc.setFadedOutAtStart(true);
180                                arc.setSingleFlickerMode(true);
181                                
182                                Vector2f pt = Vector2f.add(from, to, new Vector2f());
183                                pt.scale(0.5f);
184                                
185                                Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("abyssal_glare_lightning", 1f, 1f, pt, new Vector2f());
186                        }
187                        
188                }
189                
190                if (normalWeaponMode) {
191                        Vector2f pt = Vector2f.add(from, to, new Vector2f());
192                        pt.scale(0.5f);
193                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playLoop("abyssal_glare_loop", 
194                                                                                         beam.getSource(), 1f, beam.getBrightness(),
195                                                                                         pt, beam.getSource().getVelocity());
196                } else if (primary) {
197                        Vector2f pt = Vector2f.add(from, to, new Vector2f());
198                        pt.scale(0.5f);
199                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playLoop("darkened_gaze_loop", 
200                                         beam.getSource(), 1f, beam.getBrightness(),
201                                         pt, beam.getSource().getVelocity());
202                }
203        }
204        
205
206
207        public DamagingExplosionSpec createExplosionSpec(float damageMult) {
208                float damage = RIFT_DAMAGE * damageMult;
209                DamagingExplosionSpec spec = new DamagingExplosionSpec(
210                                0.1f, // duration
211                                75f, // radius
212                                50f, // coreRadius
213                                damage, // maxDamage
214                                damage / 2f, // minDamage
215                                CollisionClass.PROJECTILE_FF, // collisionClass
216                                CollisionClass.PROJECTILE_FIGHTER, // collisionClassByFighter
217                                3f, // particleSizeMin
218                                3f, // particleSizeRange
219                                0.5f, // particleDuration
220                                0, // particleCount
221                                new Color(255,255,255,0), // particleColor
222                                new Color(255,100,100,0)  // explosionColor
223                                );
224
225                spec.setDamageType(DamageType.ENERGY);
226                spec.setUseDetailedExplosion(false);
227                spec.setSoundSetId("abyssal_glare_explosion");
228                spec.setSoundVolume(damageMult);
229                return spec;            
230        }
231        
232}
